record_type_quote:
A total of 1,589 unselected female twins from the TwinsUK registry completed both original and new versions of the FSFI. After applying exclusion criteria, 1,489 women were eligible for this study.
In addition, successful replication of the psychometric properties of the original FSFI was demonstrated.
